blocks.text: Jab conductor ke siron par potential difference V lagaya jaye to us mein current I behne lagta hai.

blocks.title: Ohm ka qanoon
blocks.text: Conductor mein behne wala current conductor par lagaye gaye potential difference ke seedhe tanasub mein hai, basharte conductor ki tabai halat (physical state) mein koi tabdeeli na ho (print mein 'no charge'). Riyazi taur par V, I ke tanasub mein, ya V = RI ... (9.31).
Yahan R ek constant hai jise conductor ki resistance kehte hain. Resistance ki SI unit ohm hai, jise Yunani bara harf omega zahir karta hai.

blocks.title: Ek ohm
blocks.text: Conductor ki resistance 1 ohm hai agar us ke siron par 1 volt ka potential difference lagane se us mein 1 ampere current behe.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: lambai L aur raqba A ke taar mein electrons baen taraf drift karte hue jabke conventional current daen taraf, I = nAvq ke saath. Oopar daen: V ke muqable I ka seedha graph jis ki dhalwan R hai, aur temperature ke saath seedhi lakeer mein barhti copper ki resistivity. Neeche baen: resistivities aur temperature coefficients ki Table 9.2. Neeche daen: internal resistance r wala emf E ka cell R se current chalata hua, voltmeter, switch aur power aur emf ke formulae ke saath.
blocks.caption: Electric current, resistance aur resistivity, power, emf aur internal resistance (Figures 9.20 se 9.26 aur topics 9.10 se 9.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Taar mein azaad electrons field ke khilaf aahista drift karte hain, jabke conventional current ulat simt mein liya jata hai; current fi unit volume carriers ki tadaad zarb raqba, drift speed aur charge ke barabar hai. Muqarrar tabai halat wale conductor mein potential difference current ke tanasub mein hai, to V ke muqable I ka graph seedhi lakeer hai jis ki dhalwan resistance hai. Resistance lambai ke saath barhti aur raqbe ke saath ghatti hai, maadde ki resistivity ke zariye, aur dhaaton mein temperature ke saath barabar barhti hai. Cell ka emf aur internal resistance hota hai: switch khula ho to voltmeter emf parhta hai, aur current behe to terminal voltage current zarb internal resistance jitna gir jata hai.

blocks.caption: Ohm ka qanoon ek nazar mein

blocks.prompt: Conductor 6.0 V se jorne par us mein 3.0 A current hai. Us ki resistance kya hai, aur kitni power istemal hoti hai (MCQ 9.8)?
blocks.explanation: R = V/I = 6.0/3.0 = 2.0 ohm, aur P = VI = 6.0 x 3.0 = 18 W, option (d).

items: Ohm ka qanoon: agar tabai halat (maslan temperature) na badle to I, V ke tanasub mein; V = RI (9.31); R ohms mein; 1 ohm 1 V par 1 A guzarta hai.
